newsitem.title: UK: UK energy minister wants more competition.
newsitem.headline: UK energy minister wants more competition.

text.p: Competition in Britain's power generation industry is increasing but is still inadequate, Energy Minister Lord Fraser of Carmyllie said on Monday.
"We are not of the view that sufficient competition has been achieved in the electricity supply market," Fraser told parliament's trade and industry committee.
But with significant extra generating capacity due to come on stream over the next 18 months, he said the trend toward greater competition was "irreversible" and was gathering momentum.

Fraser said he did not expect price reductions for residential users when the market was fully opened up in 1998 to match the 20-25 percent drop in gas prices that resulted from giving households in southwest England the right to shop around for supplies.
